results.primary_cause: Evidence confirms a period of stronger dry-bulk freight rates and Capesize demand, but counter-evidence indicates that the 2026 strength may be temporary and affected by rerouting and prospective vessel oversupply; durable commodity-volume causality remains unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: A key dry-bulk freight measure reached its highest level since December 2023 in May 2026, driven by rising Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

supporting_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially affected by forced rerouting and may reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: The reported strength may be an artificial rerouting effect rather than durable commodity-volume demand, and a 2027 vessel supply glut was warned about.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry Bulk Shipping Faces 2027 Supply Glut: BIMCO Warns Hormuz Rerouting Boost Will Reverse

results.primary_cause: Available evidence supports continued storage-market activity but does not establish a sufficiently exact, time-consistent NAND pricing, inventory and utilization cycle; conflicting structural supply-demand evidence prevents ACTIVE classification.

supporting_evidence.claim: The 2026 Future of Memory and Storage Conference highlighted continued growth in storage and memory markets, including data-center and SSD-related demand.
supporting_evidence.source_title: 2026 FMS Shows Storage And Memory Market Continued Growth

supporting_evidence.claim: A NAND controller supplier described storage demand as evolving across consumer devices and data centers.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

counter_evidence.claim: The NAND market is undergoing structural changes that may prevent the historical supply cycle from translating directly into a broad, synchronized upcycle.
counter_evidence.source_title: The Next NAND Decade: Why Supply Can’t Catch Demand The Way It Used To
